reels.kit: launch-kit-v2 (c) 6, 'It's not a day, it's a season'

captions.text: Your Saturn return is not a birthday. Nobody's is.
Saturn takes about 29½ years to go round.
It comes back to the degree it held when you were born…

words.text: If someone tells you it hits at 29,
If they can't say, they're guessing.
